name: alibaba_com-mcp
description: Alibaba.com (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, set_inventory, update_listing, end_listing. Every

platform_mcp_alibaba_com_app_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_COM_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_alibaba_com_app_key.description: App Key of your Alibaba.com Open Platform app (https://openapi.alibaba.com/ App Console; admin-reviewed).

platform_mcp_alibaba_com_app_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_COM_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_alibaba_com_app_secret.description: App Secret of the same app; signs every call: uppercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the API path without '/rest' (e.g. /alibaba/order/get) + the parameters sorted by name as name+value (docId=61). Never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_alibaba_com_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_COM_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_alibaba_com_access_token.description: access_token from the authorisation-code exchange /auth/token/create (https://openapi.alibaba.com/doc/api.htm#/api?cid=4&path=/auth/token/create). It expires after expires_in seconds; renew it with /auth/token/refresh (a signed call) and update this value — the runtime does not refresh it.

tools.name: me
tools.description: alibaba order list (role=seller, one row): verifies the app signature and the seller's access_token.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: alibaba order list with role=seller: the GGS seller's orders (trade_id, trade_status, create/modify timestamps in ms). `status` is an Alibaba trade status (e.g. unpay, undeliver, delivering, completed; list at docId=131); `since` filters by creation time. Amounts and products: /alibaba/order/get (not mapped for channels).

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: Edit Product Inventory: sets the PRODUCT-level real-time inventory of `listing_id` (product_id). Check `success`/`error` (result.success, result.message); SKU-level stock (sku_inventory) is not mapped.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: Edit Product Price: sets a single USD tier (from 1 unit) as the product-level price of `listing_id` ('Currency, USD only'). Tiered, range and SKU prices beyond that are not mapped; title/description edits are not mapped.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: Change listing status (action=offline): takes product `listing_id` offline; `success` is false with per-product errors otherwise.
